name: Trust condition keys are modeled with correct polarity (IAM-803)
note: IAM-803 extends the Phase-5 condition classifier for the trust condition keys (docs/trust-policy-semantics.md section 4). sts:ExternalId is the confused-deputy correlation value (a constraint - never authentication, never a secret), and aws:SourceArn / aws:SourceAccount are the confused-deputy constraints for the calling service/resource. Because these keys are now UNDERSTOOD, a cross-account trust that carries them is NOT reported as having unsupported conditions and coverage stays complete - fixing the incoherence where the trust evaluator credited ExternalId as a constraint while the classifier still called it 'not modelled'. Classification is text-only; it never asserts a runtime STS allow/deny.
